topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
Which of the following is one the objectives of accounting policies ?

III. Provide information that clearly portray nonfinancial transactions.
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC46 question bank).

topic: GI Accounts Preparation & Regulation of Investment
t:
From the financial statements of ABC General Insurance Company Ltd, the following data has been collected
Management expenses - Yr. 2010 -11 is Rs. 1,01,000 and for Yr. 2011-12 is 90,000

Net Premium - Yr. 2010 -11 is Rs. 4,90,000 and for Yr. 2011-12 is 5,20,000
Gross Direct Premium. - Yr. 2010 -11 is 8,60,000 and for Yr. 2011-12 is 9,50,000
Incurred claims - Yr. 2010 -11 is 4,60,000 and for Yr. 2011-12 is 5,50,000
Gross profit (PBT) - Yr. 2011-12 - 1,50,000

e: Correct answer: 28.85% (from the IC46 question bank).
